question: Consider the integer\[N = 9 + 99 + 999 + 9999 + \cdots + \underbrace{99\ldots 99}_\text{321 digits}.\]Find the sum of the digits of $N$.
solution:
The term with k nines equals 10^k − 1, so adding all 321 terms gives N = (10¹ + 10² + ⋯ + 10³²¹) − 321. The sum in parentheses has a 1 in each position from 10¹ through 10³²¹ and a 0 in the units position: it is 321 ones followed by a zero.
Its last four digits are 1110. Since 1110 − 321 = 789, those four digits become 0789, with no borrowing from the preceding 321 − 3 = 318 ones. Hence the digit sum is 318 + 0 + 7 + 8 + 9 = 342.
Final answer: 342
